entity.name: Allianz Colombia Consumer Insurance Plan (Autos, Motos, Taxis, & Salud)
criteria: Is the plan offered by Allianz Colombia?
Is the plan for Autos, Motos, Taxis, or Salud category?
Does the plan have a unique slug and display name?
Is pricing information (min price or "quote") available?
Does the plan have at least 4 canonical benefits?
Is the source URL an official Allianz Colombia domain (allianz.co or relevant allianz.com section for Colombia)?
Is the last verification date within 180 days of the scrape timestamp?
entity.description: Consumer-facing insurance plans offered by Allianz Colombia, specifically for Autos, Motos, Taxis, and Salud categories, with all required attributes and meeting strict inclusion criteria.

attributes.name: provider_slug
attributes.description: A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the insurance provider. Must be "allianz".

attributes.name: provider_display
attributes.description: The display name of the insurance provider.

attributes.name: plan_slug
attributes.description: A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the insurance plan, unique per provider.

attributes.name: plan_display
attributes.description: The display name of the insurance plan.

attributes.name: price_min
attributes.description: The minimum price of the insurance plan, if available.

attributes.name: benefits
attributes.description: A list of canonical benefit codes offered by the plan. Must have at least 4 items.

attributes.name: benefit_details
attributes.description: A detailed description of the benefits.

attributes.name: deductible
attributes.description: The deductible amount for the plan. Can be null if only found in unparseable PDFs (relevant for Autos).

attributes.name: copay
attributes.description: The copay amount for the plan. Can be null if only found in unparseable PDFs (relevant for Salud).

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: The waiting period in days before certain benefits become active.

attributes.name: geo_scope
attributes.description: The geographical scope of the plan. Can be null if not visible.

attributes.name: target_personas
attributes.description: The target audience or personas for the plan. Can be null if not visible.

attributes.name: last_verified_at
attributes.description: The timestamp when the plan details were last verified (scrape timestamp).

attributes.name: source_primary_url
attributes.description: The primary official Allianz Colombia URL where the plan details were found.

attributes.name: external_purchase_url
attributes.description: A URL where the plan can be purchased or a quote can be obtained externally.

attributes.name: category_slug
attributes.description: The category of the insurance plan. Must be either "autos", "motos", "taxis", or "salud".

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: The currency of the insurance plan price. Must be 'COP' for Colombian Pesos.
